At delta=0 the full separated problem depends on (m1,m2) only through m1+m2, so the equal-spin degenerate set at fixed (l,m) is a single irreducible SU(2) multiplet of dimension l+1. Because (m1,m2) label permanently decoupled blocks at every delta, this degeneracy provably cannot become defective: a structural no-go removing specification target 2.1. Radial structure also derived exactly: r=0 is an ordinary point for ab!=0, the problem is confluent-Heun type (two regular singular points + irregular infinity), the horizon exponent is (omega - m1*Om_a - m2*Om_b)/(2*kappa), and the potential is exactly even in r so there is no Coulomb tail and the asymptotic exponent is exactly -3/2.
